interpretation: Planner-family full-layer closure is 0.892--0.895 and does not establish a strategy advantage over the strong period-aware baselines.
The paired extended audit reports lower wrong-document rate and a multi-document closure advantage against generic, HiREC-style and single-shot baselines.
Obligation exactness is only 0.45--0.46; file closure is not answer accuracy.
metadata_v9_fill is exactly tied with finplan_v9_cascade, so the public full set attributes the gain to obligation representation rather than cascade policy.

lofin_validation8.interpretation: Frozen validation supports the representation-layer hypothesis; it does not identify an independent retrieval-policy gain.

interpretation: The benchmark uses self-derived single-document gold sets and reports file-level closure, not answer accuracy.

The internal method is significantly higher in closure than the listed baselines in the combined audit, but v9 and metadata-fill are identical because the annual-report corpus leaves little retrieval-policy freedom.
No comparison here is a leaderboard or SOTA claim.

sec_real_point_in_time.interpretation: Point-in-time filtering is supported as a leakage-control mechanism; the pilot is descriptive and not a confirmatory strategy comparison.

china_mixed_period_pilot.interpretation: Mechanism pilot only; page-level field-oracle and regex reader results are not an LLM answer benchmark and have no significance claim.
